candidates.title: In Rajasthan Civic Polls, BJP Scoops Up 204 Boards, Congress Trails With 96
candidates.excerpt: The BJP's performance has suprised many, especially in the tribal belt.In the nine urban local bodies across the tribal-dominated districts of Banswara, Dungarpur and Pratapgarh, the BJP has formed boards in seven.
